text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In that previous race, I put on an unsightly display
unbefitting of the Rose Clan...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I cannot bear to show that to everyone ever again—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: With this single race, I resolved to consign that humiliation to the past.
choice_data_list: I believe in Lady Rose's victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, those words of yours
are worth an army of ten thousand.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us go.
I shall paint the turf in the hues of roses.
